name: Vision of Elapsing Eons

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: One visible creature saves Intelligence or takes 10d12 Psychic and becomes Paralyzed. Repeat at turn end: failure adds 1 Exhaustion; success ends the spell. Another creature within 5 feet can end it with an action to shake the target awake.
